zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.server.gesperrt: This server does not allow zooming with the key. Use a spyglass.
zoom.seite.zoom.info: Starting zoom, limit and scroll steps
zoom.seite.kamera.info: Mouse, hand, HUD and third person while zooming
zoom.seite.fernrohr.info: Spyglass with this zoom, overlay and sounds
zoom.seite.tasten.info: Zoom key and keys for the zoom level
zoom.o.basis.info: Zooming starts at this level. 0 % = no zoom, 100 % = 50×.
zoom.o.maximum.info: Limit for the mouse wheel. 0 % disables zooming, 100 % = 50×.
zoom.o.schritt.info: How much one scroll notch zooms. 100 % = 1.25× per notch, 200 % = two notches.
zoom.o.zuruecksetzen.info: On: every zoom starts at the starting zoom. Off: the last level is remembered.
zoom.o.weich.info: Field of view changes smoothly instead of jumping.
zoom.o.start.info: How long zooming in takes. 0 s = instant.
zoom.o.stopp.info: How long zooming out takes. 0 s = instant.
zoom.o.scroll_tempo.info: How fast smooth zoom follows the mouse wheel. 100 % = normal.
zoom.o.maus.info: Mouse slows down to match the zoom so it feels normal.
zoom.o.weiche_kamera.info: Camera moves smoothly while zooming (like vanilla's cinematic camera).
zoom.o.dritte_person.info: Zooming in rear view uses first person so your player doesn't block the view.
zoom.o.hand_aus.info: Hand and held item are invisible while zooming.
zoom.o.hud.info: When the HUD stays visible while zooming.
zoom.o.fernrohr_zoom.info: The spyglass zooms like the zoom key (mouse wheel, animation) instead of a fixed 10×.
zoom.o.overlay.info: When the spyglass view with its black border is shown.
zoom.o.toene.info: When the spyglass sounds are played.
